body:
# pfQuest 8.0.0

This release is a comprehensive performance overhaul. The focus was eliminating microfreezes and per-frame waste that had accumulated across the codebase, from database searches down to individual pin position updates.

---

## For Users

### Microfreezes eliminated
Picking up a quest, completing one, opening a bag after looting, or changing zones would previously cause brief but noticeable hitches. These are gone. Quest objective lookups, bag-scan debouncing, questgiver refresh, map node updates, and database searches have all been made significantly faster or deferred to avoid blocking the game loop.

### Questgiver pins refresh less often
Quest givers on the map now only refresh when something actually changes your available quests — level, class, race, or professions. Objective-only changes (kill 4/10 → 5/10) no longer trigger a full questgiver re-scan across the entire database.

### Map and minimap pins are smoother
Opening the world map no longer triggers a cascade of redundant updates. Pins update instantly when you change zones, disappear cleanly when zooming out to the continent view, and are skipped entirely when nothing has changed.

### Browser search no longer lags while typing
The database browser search box now waits for a brief pause before searching, instead of re-running on every keystroke.

### Favorites load smoothly at login
Bookmarked database entries are loaded incrementally in the background at login rather than all at once, eliminating a stutter on first load.

### Quest journal is more responsive
The journal now updates only when new history is recorded, rather than on a fixed polling interval.

---

## For Developers

### Database (`database.lua`)

- **`BAG_UPDATE` burst debounce with pending flag**: the first `BAG_UPDATE` in a burst sets a scheduled deadline and a `pending` flag; subsequent events within the burst window are ignored. The flag is cleared when the scan actually runs, so the next burst can schedule a new scan. Applies to both `OnEvent` and the `TrackQuestItemDependency` path.
- **Zero-allocation table swap on bag scan**: the item dependency table (`db`) is swapped in-place with a pre-allocated `db_tmp` scratch table rather than re-creating it. The old table is cleared with `pairs` and becomes the next `db_tmp`, so no new table is ever allocated per scan.
- **`SearchQuests` delta caching via fingerprint**: questgiver search results are cached and only recomputed when the player's level, class, race, or profession skills actually change. A string fingerprint (`questgiverFingerprint`) is compared before each run; unchanged fingerprints are skipped entirely.
- **`staticRejectSet`**: unit/object type rejection during search is a pre-built set lookup instead of a repeated conditional chain.
- **`skillcache`**: player profession skill lines are concatenated into a single string and cached for the duration of a search pass.
- **O(1) `DeleteNode`** via reverse index: a node-to-source mapping eliminates full-table scans on deletion.
- **`parse_obj` reuse** (`clear_parse_obj`): the objective-parse scratch table is cleared in-place between calls instead of being discarded.
- **`queueCount` counter**: tracks queue size as an integer to avoid O(n) `tsize()` calls on the hot path.

### Quest Log (`quest.lua`)

- **`needsQuestGiverUpdate` flag**: the processing queue now distinguishes between `NEW`/`REMOVE` entries (which require questgiver refresh) and `RELOAD`/objective-change entries (which do not). `updateQuestGivers` is only set when at least one `NEW` or `REMOVE` entry was processed since the last drain.
- **`ResetAll` invalidates fingerprint**: calling `pfQuest:ResetAll()` now also clears `pfDatabase.questgiverFingerprint`, forcing the next questgiver scan to run unconditionally.
- **Flip-flop quest log table**: `questlog_flip` / `questlog_flop` alternates without allocating a new table on each `QUEST_LOG_UPDATE`.
- **`table.concat` state string**: quest-state string comparison uses `table.concat` instead of repeated concatenation, eliminating intermediate string garbage.
- **`pfJournal.dirty` integration**: sets `pfJournal.dirty = true` when quest history is written, triggering journal reload without polling.
- **Debug pane font follows pfUI settings**.

### Map (`map.lua`)

- **`questBusy` guard**: `UpdateNodes` is skipped while quest log processing is in flight (`queueCount > 0`, `updateQuestGivers`, `updateQuestLog` flags).
- **`queue_update` debounce**: `WORLD_MAP_UPDATE` and all external callers route through a 0.25s settle timer instead of calling `UpdateNodes` directly. Previously fired ~100 times on map open.
- **`dirtyMaps` / `dirtyNodes`**: zone-scoped and node-scoped invalidation sets — `UpdateNodes` and `UpdateMinimap` skip zones and pins that haven't changed since the last render.
- **Four distinct `WORLD_MAP_UPDATE` cases**: continent → hide all pins; map-open burst → debounce; zone change → immediate update; dirty same zone → stamp debounce.
- **Worldmap pin position cache** (`pin.lastX` / `pin.lastY`): `ClearAllPoints` + `SetPoint` only called when the pixel position actually changes. Surplus-hidden pins have their cache cleared to `nil`.
- **`UpdateMinimap` `UpdateNode` guard**: skips the `highlightdb` rebuild and node iteration when the pin already displays the correct node and that node is not dirty.

### Route (`route.lua`)

- **Player path draw cache** (`lastDrawX` / `lastDrawY` / `lastDrawNode`): `ClearPath` / `DrawLine` is skipped when the player hasn't moved meaningfully and the target node is unchanged. Cache is cleared in `Reset` and on `wrongmap`.
- **Continent zoom clears paths**: `GetCurrentMapZone() == 0` correctly clears all three route paths and resets `firstnode`, preventing stale paths from persisting when zooming to the continent view.
- **`pairs` → `ipairs`** in four coordinate-iteration loops.

### Tracker (`tracker.lua`)

- **`buttonByTitle` reverse map**: tracker button lookup is O(1) via a title → index reverse map instead of a linear scan of `tracker.buttons` on every update.
- **`OnUpdate` throttle**: tracker frame update is rate-limited to avoid redundant per-frame work.

### Browser (`browser.lua`)

- **Search debounce**: `OnTextChanged` sets a pending flag; search fires after 0.2s of inactivity via `OnUpdate`, not on every keystroke.
- **`UpdateNodes` calls debounced**: `ResultButtonClick` and `ResultButtonClickSpecial` now route through `pfMap.queue_update` instead of calling `pfMap:UpdateNodes()` directly.
- **`favqueue` incremental drain**: `PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD` builds the favorites queue; `OnUpdate` drains one entry per 0.1s tick instead of loading all at once.
- **`GetMouseFocus` guard**: skipped entirely when multi-select is idle.

### Slash Commands (`slashcmd.lua`)

- **`/db quests` debounced**: routes through `pfMap.queue_update` instead of calling `pfMap:UpdateNodes()` directly.

### Journal (`journal.lua`)

- **`dirty` flag replaces polling**: `OnUpdate` no longer runs `ReloadJournal` on a timer; it fires only when `pfJournal.dirty` is set (by `quest.lua` on history change, or on `OnShow`).

### Compatibility (`compat/pfUI.lua`)

- **`CreateScrollChild` `OnUpdate` guard**: caches `_lastRange` and `_lastHeight`; `UpdateScrollState` is only called when either value changes, eliminating 60+ redundant calls per second per scroll frame.

### Code Quality

- `pairs` replaced with `ipairs` throughout all array-type iterations where order and contiguity are guaranteed.
- All profiling instrumentation removed from production paths.
- Codebase-wide formatting pass: consistent spacing around operators and concatenation, explicit `0.x` float literals, and one-liner conditionals expanded for readability.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/The-Kludge-Bureau/pfQuest/compare/7.0.1...8.0.0
